nodes.name: rigidbody.cpp
nodes.summary: Implements project gravity load plus Rigidbody force accumulation, velocity clear, and semi-implicit Euler integration with drag.

nodes.name: rigidbody.h
nodes.summary: Declares Rigidbody mass/drag/restitution/friction, ForceMode, and the engine gravity getters used during integration.

nodes.name: script_runtime_api.cpp
nodes.summary: Host-side ScriptRuntimeApi table and ScriptApi_* thunks that let content DLLs drive audio, physics, camera, UI, particles, and prefabs.
nodes.languageNotes: C-style function-pointer table (version 42) plus thin ScriptApi_* wrappers that call through ScriptRuntimeApi_GetHost().
